provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Graduation medley
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
list graduation songs
sing in sequence

Introduction:
We love singing songs
Today we mix many songs

Content:
Graduation medley is a mix
of our best songs
We sing one after another
Like a train of songs

Class activity:
Line up like a train
Each child sings one song

Evaluation questions:
What is a medley?
Name two graduation songs
Show how to stand in line

Summary:
We practiced our song medley
For graduation day.

topics.title: Solo performances
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
perform a solo song
hold the mic properly

Introduction:
We sing together
Today we sing alone

Content:
Solo means one person singing
Each child gets turn
Hold mic with two hands
Sing loud and clear

Class activity:
Pass the mic around
Each child sings one line

Evaluation questions:
What does solo mean?
How do we hold a mic?
Show your best singing face

Summary:
We practiced solo singing
Like big stars.

topics.title: Group dances
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
dance in groups
copy simple steps

Introduction:
We love to move our bodies
Today we dance in teams

Content:
Group dance means many friends
dancing together
We hold hands or stand close
Copy the teacher's steps

Class activity:
Divide into three groups
Each group makes steps

Evaluation questions:
What is group dance?
Show how to stand in group
Name one dance step

Summary:
We danced together
In happy groups.

topics.title: Cultural dance
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
name one cultural dance
move like their culture

Introduction:
Nigeria has many dances
Today we learn traditional

Content:
Cultural dance is from home
Yoruba has Etighi dance
Igbo has Ikoro dance
Hausa has Daudu dance
Drum beats guide us

Class activity:
Each child shows family dance
We all copy together

Evaluation questions:
What is cultural dance?
Name one Nigerian dance
Show a dance movement

Summary:
We danced like our ancestors
With pride.

topics.title: Praise and thanks songs
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
sing thanks songs
praise teachers

Introduction:
We say thank you every day
Today we sing thanks

Content:
Praise songs say good things
Thanks songs say thank you
We sing for teachers
For helping us learn

Class activity:
Make a circle
Sing thank you song

Evaluation questions:
What do praise songs do?
Who do we thank?
Show a thank you action

Summary:
We sang happy thanks songs
For our teachers.

topics.title: Role play songs
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
act community roles
sing role songs

Introduction:
People have different jobs
Today we act and sing

Content:
Role play is pretending
We can be doctor or teacher
Or driver or farmer
Each job has a song

Class activity:
Children choose roles
Act and sing their job

Evaluation questions:
What is role play?
Name one community job
Show your job action

Summary:
We acted like workers
With happy songs.

topics.title: Rhythm patterns
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
copy clap patterns
see dots as music

Introduction:
Music has patterns
Today we make patterns

Content:
Rhythm is beat of music
We clap patterns like clap - clap - pause
Dots show where to clap
One dot is one clap

Class activity:
Teacher claps patterns
Children copy exactly

Evaluation questions:
What is rhythm?
Copy this clap pattern
What do dots mean?

Summary:
We made music patterns
With our hands.

topics.title: Concert etiquette
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
enter stage nicely
bow and exit well

Introduction:
On stage we behave well
Today we learn manners

Content:
Concert etiquette is stage manners
We enter quietly from side
Bow with hands at sides
Exit without pushing

Class activity:
Practice entering and bowing
Walk like kings and queens

Evaluation questions:
What is etiquette?
Show how to bow
How do we exit?

Summary:
We learned stage manners
Like proper performers.

topics.title: Dress rehearsal
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
perform on stage
check costumes

Introduction:
We practiced many times
Today we go on stage

Content:
Dress rehearsal is full practice
We wear our graduation clothes
Sing all our songs
Check everything works

Class activity:
Go on stage and perform
Teacher checks costumes

Evaluation questions:
What is dress rehearsal?
Show your costume
What do we check?

Summary:
We practiced on stage
Ready for graduation.

topics.title: Graduation concert
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to
perform for parents
show graduation joy

Introduction:
Parents come to watch
Today we show our work

Content:
Graduation concert is big show
We sing and dance for parents
Wear our best clothes
Be happy and proud

Class activity:
Perform full program
Parents clap for us

Evaluation questions:
Who watches our concert?
How do we feel?
Show graduation joy

Summary:
We performed beautifully
Happy to graduate.
